new_result.name: QFORM-PAIRCOLLISION-CROSSBLOCK-v1
new_result.statement: If R=X^T S X+b^T X+c has a disjoint k-by-k physical cross block C=S[I,J], then |phi_R(t)|^2<=min(1,pi^k |det C|^-1 |t|^-k), proved from the exact joint sum/difference pair density without U/V independence. For k=2, combining with the designated partner square-pivot theorem and optimizing alpha=1/sqrt(2) gives ||p_Q||inf<=4(1+sqrt(2))|d|^-1/2|det C|^-1/4.
